name: opencode-async-prompt-injector
description: Injects prompts into your OpenCode agent mid-task without interrupting its flow. Like a sticky note slid under the agent's nose while it's busy thinking.

installation.summary: Add the plugin to your opencode.json plugins array and restart OpenCode.
installation.markdown:
## Installation

Add it to your [opencode.json](https://opencode.ai/docs/config/):

```json
{
  "plugins": ["opencode-async-prompt-injector"]
}
```

Restart OpenCode.

usage.markdown:
## Usage

While the agent is thinking or using tools, type:

```
/inject_prompt <your message>
```

The agent reads the message and acts on it within the current flow, without interrupting its work.

**Examples:**

- `/inject_prompt Hey, I just updated the tests — check them too`
- `/inject_prompt Change of plans: postpone item #7 until the next round`

> **Note:** Model compatibility varies. Some models may treat the injected message as the end of the turn and stop. If something feels off, try a different model.
